steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 39
steps.text: In this C1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I always procrastinate on Sunday nights.
I finally got used to waking up early.
The traffic was terrible this morning.

steps.title: Prática de Pronúncia
steps.text: Fale a seguinte frase em voz alta no microfone:

steps.title: Organize a Frase
steps.question: Ordene as palavras para formar a frase: "I finally got used to waking up early."

steps.title: Gramática: Passive Voice
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Passive Voice"?
options: The documents will be sent tomorrow.
If she knew, she would tell us.
If you study, you will pass the exam.

steps.title: Idiom: Cost an arm and a leg
steps.text: It means: "To be very expensive.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: That car cost an arm and a leg.
